requested_components.instructions: Extract each distinct current requested work component as a complete exact source span. Include the action, its object, and all attached qualifiers that constrain its method, evidence, format, or acceptance criteria. Do not stop before a trailing phrase such as using citations, with examples, or under a specified limit. Split coordinated actions into separate list items. Exclude background examples and global prohibitions. Never shorten a component to only its action and noun if a modifier follows.

constraints.instructions: Extract complete exact spans of all explicit current constraints and prohibitions, wherever they occur in the assembled context or current request. Include the whole negation and the complete prohibited action and object. A fragment such as Do, not, or no is never a complete constraint. Preserve scope and exceptions. Do not extract historical requests or descriptive background as new instructions.
